import.title: Import a design system
import.subtitle: Bring in a design system made in Claude: colours, fonts, logos and the brand book become one brand kit.
import.dropHint: Claude design system (.zip), brand book (.md), tokens (.json) or tokens.css · up to 60 MB
import.readingHint: Colours, fonts, logos and the brand book are read. Nothing is saved yet.
import.summary: {colours} colours · {fonts} font files · {logos} logos · {images} images · {docs} documents
import.bookHeadings: Brand book read by its headings
import.makeDefault: Make it the default brand kit
import.imageryHint: Saved to your library as brand reference images.
import.nothing: Nothing usable was found in this file.
import.tokensMore: Also in the file: {spacing} spacing, {radius} radius and {shadow} shadow tokens and {components} component files (kept out: posts do not need them).
import.photoStyle: Camera style from the imagery rules

health.title: Brand health
health.subtitle: What the AI and the designs know about this brand
health.accepted: Added to the form. Save to keep it.
health.noSuggestions: The AI had nothing to add.
health.saveToUpdate: Save the kit to update the score.
health.fontsHint: Used by designs, carousels and templates; Tajawal draws any letter a file does not have.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: Add the logo for light backgrounds.

logo_dark.label: Logo for dark backgrounds
logo_dark.hint: Add a white or light version for dark photos and fills.

description.label: About the brand
description.hint: Two or three sentences on what the brand offers.

audience.label: Audience
audience.hint: Say who the posts are written for.

color_secondary.label: Second colour
color_secondary.hint: Pick a second colour for gradients and shapes.

color_accent.label: Accent colour
color_accent.hint: Pick an accent for buttons and highlights.

color_text.label: Text colour
color_text.hint: Pick the colour of text on the main colour.

color_background.label: Background colour
color_background.hint: Pick the page or card background.

contrast.label: Text contrast
contrast.hint: Text on the main colour needs at least 4.5:1.

font_family.label: Body font
font_family.hint: Choose the font for running text.

font_arabic.label: Arabic in the brand fonts
font_arabic.hint: A brand font cannot draw Arabic: Tajawal is used instead, or pick an Arabic font.

personality.label: Personality
personality.hint: Add two or more words that describe the brand.

language_style.label: Language
language_style.hint: Choose the language or dialect of the posts.

emoji_style.label: Emojis
emoji_style.hint: Say whether the brand uses emojis.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.hint: Add the usual call to action.

banned_words.label: Words to avoid
banned_words.hint: List words the brand never uses.

sample_posts.label: Example posts
sample_posts.hint: Add two or more posts in the brand's voice.

visual_style.label: Visual style
visual_style.hint: Describe how photos and designs should look.

visual_rules.label: Visual rules
visual_rules.hint: Add do and don't rules for visuals.

guard_mode.label: Brand guard
guard_mode.hint: Turn the brand guard on so posts follow the kit.
